title.zh: 一个八音盒 = 一个音序器
title.en: A music box is a sequencer

lead.zh: 圆筒转起来，梳齿碰到凸起就发出声音。
lead.en: The drum turns; a tooth that meets a pin sounds.

say.zh: 圆筒转动时，梳齿碰到凸起就发出声音。
say.en: As the drum turns, a tooth of the comb sounds whenever it meets a pin.

say.zh: 把圆筒摊平：从左到右是时间，从下到上是音高，绿线是正在播放的位置。这就是音序器。
say.en: Unroll the drum: time runs left to right, pitch bottom to top, and the green line is what is playing now. That is a sequencer.

say.zh: 点一个空格子，加一个音（就像在圆筒上多装一个凸起），再点一下就去掉。在鸣片上，这 16 个时间格就是机器右边 4×4 的 16 个键，音高用左边的琴键来选。
say.en: Tap an empty cell to add a note (a new pin on the drum); tap it again to take it away. On Cardenza these 16 steps are the 16 keys of the 4×4 block on the right; you pick the pitch on the keyboard to the left.

title.en: Four music boxes make a part

lead.zh: 一个乐器不够，就多买几个。
lead.en: One instrument is not enough: get more.

say.zh: 一个八音盒只有一种声音。
say.en: One music box has one sound.

say.zh: 再来三个：鼓、钢琴、和弦、贝斯，一起播放。
say.en: Add three more: drums, piano, chords, bass, all playing together.

say.zh: 每个八音盒是一条轨道，它转的那一圈叫 Pattern。四轨一起播放，就是一段完整的乐句。
say.en: Each box is a track, and its loop is a pattern. Four tracks playing together make a whole phrase.

title.zh: 很多段排起来 = 一首歌
title.en: Parts in a row make a song

lead.zh: 一段只有几秒，歌要长得多。
lead.en: A part lasts seconds; a song is longer.

say.zh: 一段只有几秒钟。
say.en: One part lasts a few seconds.

say.zh: 多做几段（前奏、A、B……），从左往右一段接一段地播。
say.en: Make a few parts (an intro, A, B…) and play them one after another, left to right.

say.zh: 这就是一首歌（SONG）。每一段里，每条轨道选自己的一个 Pattern（P01、P02……），也可以空着不播（--）。在机器上，它在 {{scene:TAPE}} 场景里排。
say.en: That is a song. In each part every track picks one of its own patterns (P01, P02, …) or stays silent (--). On Cardenza you arrange it in scene {{scene:TAPE}}.

say.zh: 左边 8 列是琴键：按一下，出声。
say.en: The 8 columns on the left are the keyboard: press one to play.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r3c3; wait 12; tap r3c5

say.zh: 右边 4×4 对着屏幕中间的格子：点一个，选中它。
say.en: The 4×4 on the right matches the cells on the screen: tap one to pick it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：改它的值。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}}: change its value.

steps.demo: tap SUB; tap SUB; tap SUB; tap ADD

say.zh: 最左、最右各 4 个键，每个键管一件事。按一按试试：
say.en: The 4 keys at each edge, one job each. Try them:

lead.en: Play the keys, change the sound.

say.zh: 弹琴键：和钢琴一样，下面一行白键，上面一行黑键。
say.en: Play the keys: like a piano, white keys below, black keys above.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r2c2; wait 90; shot

keymarks.zh: 白键，从左下角的 C3 开始
keymarks.en: White keys, from C3 at the bottom left

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：换一个音色，名字在屏幕最上面。
say.en: {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}}: another sound. Its name is at the top of the screen.

say.zh: 再弹一下，听听新音色。
say.en: Play again and hear the new sound.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r3c5

lead.zh: 大界面叫场景，场景里有好几页。
lead.en: The big screens are scenes; each has pages.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：下一个场景。{{scene:INSTR}} 音色 → {{scene:SEQ}} 音符 → {{scene:TAPE}} 编排。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: the next scene. {{scene:INSTR}} sound → {{scene:SEQ}} notes → {{scene:TAPE}} arrangement.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}} 不放：屏幕变成场景地图，一列一个场景。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}}: the screen becomes a map of the scenes, a column each.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}，点 GRID 的一列：直接去那个场景。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and tap a GRID column: straight to that scene.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; tap G4; wait 6; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：这个场景的下一页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the next page of the scene.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}} 不放：这个场景的每一页都在 GRID 上。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}}: every page of the scene is on the GRID.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; shot; up CTRL

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}}，点一格：直接去那一页。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}} and tap a cell: straight to that page.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; tap G1; wait 6; shot; up CTRL

lead.zh: 轨道就像乐队里的乐手：一个打鼓，一个弹琴，一个弹贝斯……各弹各的，合起来就是一首歌。鸣片有 4 条轨道，就是 4 个乐手，每人一种颜色。
lead.en: A track is like a player in a band: one on drums, one on keys, one on bass… each plays their own part, and together they make the song. Cardenza has 4 tracks: 4 players, a colour each.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:TAB}}：下一条轨道。屏幕最上面的颜色跟着变。
say.en: Tap {{key:TAB}}: the next track. The colour at the top of the screen follows.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 不放：GRID 上一列一条轨道。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}}: the GRID shows the tracks, a column each.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点第 1 行的一格：去那条轨道。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap a cell of the top row: that track.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; wait 6; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 1：回到 {{track:1}}，鼓。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 1: back to {{track:1}}, the drums.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G1; up TAB

lead.zh: 这五课一步一步做出一首完整的歌。先从鼓开始：底鼓、军鼓、闭镲，一段鼓点。
lead.en: These five lessons build a whole song, step by step. First the drums: kick, snare and hi-hat, one beat.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：进入 {{scene:SEQ}}，写节奏的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: {{scene:SEQ}}, where beats are written.

say.zh: 这一页是鼓机，一列一种鼓。按住第 1 列最上面的键（底鼓 BD）不放，点 GRID 1、5、9、13：底鼓放在这 4 步上。
say.en: This page is a drum machine, a drum per column. Hold the top key of column 1 (the kick, BD) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9 and 13: the kick on those 4 steps.

steps.demo: down r0c1; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：绿线走到哪一格，哪一格就响。让它一直播着。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: whichever step the green line reaches sounds. Leave it playing.

say.zh: 按住第 2 列最上面的键（军鼓 SD），点 GRID 5、13：军鼓放在第 5、13 步。
say.en: Hold the top key of column 2 (the snare, SD) and tap GRID 5 and 13: the snare on steps 5 and 13.

steps.demo: down r0c2; wait 10; tap G5; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c2; wait 20

say.zh: 闭镲也一样：按住第 3 列最上面的键（CH），点 GRID 3、7、11、15。
say.en: The hi-hat the same way: hold the top key of column 3 (CH) and tap GRID 3, 7, 11 and 15.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G3; tap G7; tap G11; tap G15; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 20

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。这段鼓点就是 P01，机器自动存着。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop. This beat is P01, kept on the device.

lead.zh: 一首歌不止一段。每一段叫一个 Pattern：把 P01 复制成 P02，再让它更热闹，留给副歌。
lead.en: A song has more than one part. Each part is a pattern: copy P01 into P02 and make it busier, for the chorus.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 PATTERN 页。一格是一段 Pattern，现在只有 P01。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the PATTERN page. A cell is a pattern; so far there is P01.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:FN}}，按 D 键：复制 P01，得到一模一样的 P02。
say.en: Hold {{key:FN}} and press D: P01 copied into P02.

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap r2c4; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点 GRID 2：换到 P02。
say.en: Tap GRID 2: switch to P02.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 两下：回到鼓机页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice: back to the drum machine.

steps.demo: tap CTRL; wait 10; tap CTRL; wait 10

say.zh: 按住第 3 列最上面的键（闭镲 CH），点 GRID 1、5、9、13：镲多了一倍，P02 更热闹。
say.en: Hold the top key of column 3 (the hi-hat, CH) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9 and 13: twice the hi-hat, a busier P02.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：听 P02。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: hear P02.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: T3 是电钢琴。打开和弦，一个键就是一个和弦：写两个，Am 和 F。
lead.en: T3 is an electric piano. With the chord on, a key is a whole chord: write two, Am and F.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 3：到 {{track:3}}，电钢琴。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 3: {{track:3}}, the electric piano.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 两下：到 {{scene:INSTR}}，这条轨的声音。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} twice: {{scene:INSTR}}, the track's sound.

steps.demo: tap ESC; wait 10; tap ESC; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点 CHORD（GRID 1）：和弦打开了。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1): the chord is on.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：回到 {{scene:SEQ}}，写和弦。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: back to {{scene:SEQ}} to write the chords.

say.zh: 按住 A 键（下面一行第 6 个白键）不放，点 GRID 1、4、7：三下 Am 和弦。
say.en: Hold the A key (6th white key of the lower row) and tap GRID 1, 4 and 7: three Am chords.

steps.demo: down r3c6; wait 10; tap G1; tap G4; tap G7; wait 10; up r3c6; wait 10

say.zh: 重复上一步，换成 F 键（第 4 个白键）：按住 F，点 GRID 9、12、15。
say.en: The step before again, with the F key (4th white key): hold F and tap GRID 9, 12 and 15.

steps.demo: down r3c4; wait 10; tap G9; tap G12; tap G15; wait 10; up r3c4; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：鼓和电钢琴一起。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: drums and piano together.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: T2 是 Juno 合成器，用它写一段旋律：6 个音，全是白键。
lead.en: T2 is a Juno synth: write a tune on it, 6 notes, all white keys.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 2：到 {{track:2}}，Juno 合成器。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 2: {{track:2}}, the Juno synth.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G2; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 按住 A 键（上面一行第 6 个白键）不放，点 GRID 1：旋律的第一个音。
say.en: Hold the A key (6th white key of the upper row) and tap GRID 1: the tune's first note.

steps.demo: down r1c6; wait 10; tap G1; wait 10; up r1c6; wait 10

say.zh: 重复上一步，照着图写完剩下 5 个音：
say.en: The step before again, for the other 5 notes as the picture shows:

steps.keys: r1c5 r1c3 r1c4 r1c1 G4 G7 G12 G9 G15
steps.demo: down r1c5; wait 6; tap G4; up r1c5; down r1c3; wait 6; tap G7; tap G12; up r1c3; down r1c4; wait 6; tap G9; up r1c4; down r1c1; wait 6; tap G15; up r1c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：鼓、电钢琴、旋律一起。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: drums, piano and tune together.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: 选一个调，弹什么都在调上。
lead.en: Pick a scale; whatever you play stays in it.

say.zh: 随便弹几个琴键：有的音放在一起很好听，有的却怎么听都不对劲，像是跑调了。有没有办法让每个键都好听、不跑调？
say.en: Play a few keys at random: some notes sound good together, others just sound wrong, out of tune. Is there a way for every key to sound right?

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r2c2; wait 12; tap r3c4; wait 12; tap r2c5; wait 12; tap r3c7

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}，按 GRID 第 1 列：进入 {{scene:SETUP}}。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and press GRID column 1: {{scene:SETUP}}.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; tap G1; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 两下：翻到 KEYS 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice: the KEYS page.

say.zh: 点 SCALE（GRID 2）：选中它。
say.en: Tap SCALE (GRID 2): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换一个音阶。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: another scale.

say.zh: 点 LAYOUT（GRID 1）：选中它。
say.en: Tap LAYOUT (GRID 1): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换成 SCALE。现在每个键都在调上，怎么按都不会错。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: SCALE. Now every key is in the scale; nothing you press is wrong.

say.zh: 弹一弹：每个键都好听了。
say.en: Play: every key sounds right now.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：回到刚才的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: back to where you were.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点 CHORD（GRID 1）：和弦打开了。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1): the chord is on.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换一种和弦。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: another chord.

say.zh: 按一个琴键：一下响了好几个音，这就是和弦。屏幕上的琴键也一起亮。
say.en: Press a key: several notes at once, that is a chord. The keys on the screen light up together.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 10; shot; up r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 ARP 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the ARP page.

say.zh: 点 ARP（GRID 1）：琶音打开了。
say.en: Tap ARP (GRID 1): the arpeggiator is on.

say.zh: 按住一个琴键：和弦的音一个一个弹出来。
say.en: Hold a key: the chord's notes come one after another.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 60; shot; wait 20; up r3c1

lead.zh: 材料齐了：鼓的 P01 和 P02、电钢琴、旋律。在 SONG 页把它们排成前奏、主歌、副歌、尾声。
lead.en: Everything is ready: the drums' P01 and P02, the piano, the tune. On the SONG page, put them in a row: intro, verse, chorus, outro.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：进入 {{scene:TAPE}}，排歌的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: {{scene:TAPE}}, where the song is put together.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 SONG 页。一列是歌的一段，从左往右播；一行是一条轨。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the SONG page. A column is a part of the song, played left to right; a row is a track.

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 1）：加第一段，前奏。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 1): the first part, the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:SUB}} 两下：{{track:1}} 换成 --，前奏先不要鼓。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}} twice: {{track:1}} becomes --, no drums in the intro.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 5）：选中它。
say.en: Tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 5): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:SUB}}：{{track:2}} 也换成 --。前奏只有电钢琴。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}}: {{track:2}} becomes -- too. The intro is just the piano.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:FN}}，按 {{key:ADD}}：前奏播 2 遍（x2）。
say.en: Hold {{key:FN}} and press {{key:ADD}}: the intro plays twice (x2).

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap ADD; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 2）：加第二段，主歌。它先照抄前奏。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 2): the second part, the verse. It starts as a copy of the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：{{track:1}} 换成 P01，鼓进来了。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: {{track:1}} on P01, in come the drums.

say.zh: 重复第 7 步，按 {{key:ADD}} 两下：主歌播 4 遍。
say.en: Step 7 again, {{key:ADD}} twice: the verse plays 4 times.

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap ADD; wait 6; tap ADD; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 3）：加第三段，副歌。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 3): the third part, the chorus.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：{{track:1}} 换成 P02，鼓更热闹。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: {{track:1}} on P02, busier drums.

say.zh: 重复第 5–6 步，这次按 {{key:ADD}}：点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 7），按 {{key:ADD}}，旋律进来了。
say.en: Steps 5–6 again, with {{key:ADD}}: tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 7), press {{key:ADD}}: in comes the tune.

steps.demo: tap G7; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 6

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 4）：加最后一段，尾声。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 4): the last part, the outro.

say.zh: 重复第 4 步：按 {{key:SUB}} 两下，{{track:1}} 换成 --。
say.en: Step 4 again: {{key:SUB}} twice, {{track:1}} becomes --.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 重复第 5–6 步：点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 8），按 {{key:SUB}}，{{track:2}} 也换成 --。
say.en: Steps 5–6 again: tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 8), press {{key:SUB}}: {{track:2}} becomes -- too.

steps.demo: tap G8; wait 10; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 按住 {{key:FN}}，按 {{key:SUB}} 两下：尾声播 2 遍。
say.en: Hold {{key:FN}} and press {{key:SUB}} twice: the outro plays twice.

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点第一段的 {{track:1}} 格（GRID 1）：回到前奏。
say.en: Tap the first part's {{track:1}} cell (GRID 1): back to the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:OK}}：歌从前奏开始（SONG 模式）。
say.en: Press {{key:OK}}: the song starts from the intro (SONG mode).

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：听你的第一首歌。前奏、主歌、副歌、尾声，播完从头再来。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: your first song. Intro, verse, chorus, outro, then from the top again.

say.zh: 听完一遍，按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。这就是你的第一首歌，机器自动存着。
say.en: Once you have heard it through, press {{key:PLAY}}: stop. That is your first song, kept on the device.

lead.zh: 启动器是一插电先出来的那个系统：装固件、换固件都靠它。它自己也会出新版本。
lead.en: The Launcher is the system that comes up first when you plug in: it installs and switches firmware. It gets new versions too.

say.zh: 拔掉 USB 线再插上：鸣片没有电池，一插电就开机，先是 203 标志，然后是启动器的首页。
say.en: Unplug the USB cable and plug it back in: Cardenza has no battery, so it starts at once, shows the 203 logo, then the Launcher's home.

say.zh: 开了 Boot last app（开机直接进上次的固件）的话，屏幕写着 Press Func to enter Launcher 时按任意键。插线时别按着侧面的 HOME 键：那是下载模式，屏幕不亮，再拔插一次就好。
say.en: With Boot last app on (straight into the last firmware), press any key while it says Press Func to enter Launcher. Don't hold the HOME key on the side while plugging in: that is download mode, a dark screen; just plug in again.

say.zh: 启动器看键帽上印的字：GRID 右下角印着黄色箭头的 {{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} 是方向键，{{key:OK}} 确认，{{key:ESC}} 返回。首页有 6 张卡片，左右翻。
say.en: The Launcher goes by the prints on the caps: the yellow arrows on {{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} at the GRID's bottom right move, {{key:OK}} confirms, {{key:ESC}} goes back. The home has 6 cards, side by side.

say.zh: 按 {{key:/}} 翻到 Download Softwares（在线下载），按 {{key:OK}}。第一次会先列出附近的 Wi-Fi：选你的网络，用键盘输入密码，按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: {{key:/}} to Download Softwares, then {{key:OK}}. The first time it lists the Wi-Fi networks nearby: pick yours, type the password, {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 在列表里选 203-Launcher，再选最上面的版本（标着 Release），然后选 Install。
say.en: In the list pick 203-Launcher, then the top version (marked Release), then Install.

say.zh: 屏幕问 Update Launcher?，默认选中的是 Back：按 {{key:,}} 选到 Update，再按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: It asks Update Launcher? with Back chosen: {{key:,}} to Update, then {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 它下载、校验，然后自己重启两次，把新启动器换上。这时别拔电。回到首页就好了：装过的固件、你的工程、SD 卡里的文件和 Wi-Fi 都还在。
say.en: It downloads and checks it, then restarts twice by itself to put the new Launcher in place. Keep it plugged in. Back on the home it is done: your firmware, projects, SD card files and Wi-Fi are all kept.

say.zh: Install 失败（启动器太旧，0.1.1 以前），或者现在没有网络？在上面那一步选 Download to SD，文件会存到卡上的 downloads 文件夹。之后在 File Browser 里选中它，选 Install，一样会问 Update Launcher?。
say.en: Install fails (a Launcher before 0.1.1), or no network right now? Choose Download to SD in that step: the file goes to the card's downloads folder. Later pick it in File Browser and choose Install; it asks Update Launcher? the same way.

lead.zh: Groovebox 是装在启动器里的一个固件。装新的、换新版本都在启动器里做，你的工程不会丢。
lead.en: The Groovebox is one firmware installed in the Launcher. New firmware and new versions go in there, and your projects stay.

say.zh: 拔掉 USB 线再插上，进启动器的首页（按键见上一课）。
say.en: Unplug the USB cable and plug it back in: the Launcher's home (the keys are in the previous lesson).

say.zh: 按 {{key:/}} 翻到 Download Softwares，按 {{key:OK}}（要连 Wi-Fi）。选 Cardenza Synth，选一个版本，再选 Install。
say.en: {{key:/}} to Download Softwares, {{key:OK}} (it needs Wi-Fi). Pick Cardenza Synth, a version, then Install.

say.zh: 选装在哪里：上面的条是机器的存储空间，黑的那段是要写的地方。按 {{key:,}} {{key:/}} 换：Free space 是另装一份；选旧的 Cardenza Synth，就是把它换成这个版本。
say.en: Choose where: the bar is the device's storage, the black part is where it goes. {{key:,}} {{key:/}} move: Free space installs another copy; the old Cardenza Synth is replaced by this version.

say.zh: 按 {{key:OK}}。替换旧版本时它再问一次 Replace?，默认选中的是 Back：按 {{key:,}} 选到 Replace，再按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: {{key:OK}}. Replacing asks Replace? with Back chosen: {{key:,}} to Replace, then {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 等进度走完：下载、写入、校验，然后重启回到启动器。这时别拔电。
say.en: Wait for it: download, write, check, then it restarts into the Launcher. Keep it plugged in.

say.zh: 打开它：第一张卡片 Software Launcher，按 {{key:OK}}，选 Cardenza Synth，再选 Launch。
say.en: Open it: the first card, Software Launcher, {{key:OK}}, pick Cardenza Synth, then Launch.

say.zh: 手上有 .bin 文件（比如测试版），就从 SD 卡装：首页 USB Mode 把卡变成电脑上的 U 盘，拷进去，先在电脑上弹出，再按 {{key:ESC}}。然后 File Browser → 选中文件 → Install，和上面一样选位置。
say.en: Got a .bin file (a test build, say)? Install it from the SD card: USB Mode makes the card a drive on your computer; copy it there, eject it on the computer, then {{key:ESC}}. Then File Browser → the file → Install, and choose where as above.

say.zh: 以后看有没有新版本：Download Softwares 列表最下面的 Check for Updates。换版本只换固件：工程、采样和设置另外存在 SD 卡和机器里，新版本打开时接着你上次的工程。
say.en: To look for new versions later: Check for Updates at the bottom of the Download Softwares list. A new version replaces only the firmware: projects, samples and settings are kept apart on the SD card and the device, and it opens on your last project.
